scope: As-built geometry, component identity, loaded radius, total mass and firmware/configuration record
controlled_conditions: Actual assembly; battery/sample/optional-equipment state; arm pose; measurement method and uncertainty
acceptance_criterion_definition: Required records complete; repeated measurements meet a declared uncertainty/repeatability budget. No assumed mass substituted for a measurement.

scope: Loaded drive speed, output torque or force, voltage, current and temperature over a declared duty interval
controlled_conditions: Document surface; load; duty duration; battery state; ambient conditions; identified motor/driver ratings
acceptance_criterion_definition: Tracking and continuous thermal/current limits satisfy identified component ratings and a predefined operating requirement. Stall ratings cannot serve as continuous limits.

scope: Steering zero, travel, backlash, rate, loaded current and independent angle feedback
controlled_conditions: Document loaded wheel condition; zero reference; measured hard/software limits; angle reference calibration
acceptance_criterion_definition: Error/rate/settling limits met throughout the declared range without interference, limit violation or overload.

scope: Repeated straight, crab and coordinated-turn motion with independent pose observations
controlled_conditions: Document surface; slope; payload; path; trial order; independent pose reference; clock alignment
acceptance_criterion_definition: Predefined path/heading error and saturation/intervention limits met on every stated surface/load condition; wheel commands and achieved motion reported separately.

scope: Cable/hose clearance, retention and strain through the identified steering/arm sweep
controlled_conditions: Identify component bend/retention requirements; document support points and approved articulation sweep
acceptance_criterion_definition: No contact, trapped loop, loss of retention or unapproved bend during the documented sweep; component-specific bend/retention requirements identified before testing.

scope: COM in several arm/payload states, wheel loading and measured support geometry
controlled_conditions: Document mass distribution and arm pose; independent support geometry; uncertainty; controlled identification method
acceptance_criterion_definition: Measured uncertainties and load cases support a predefined conservative envelope. Do not deliberately seek the model's zero-margin tipping angle.

scope: Known sample payload, grasp/place outcome, retention, contact forces, reach and arm/chassis interlock
controlled_conditions: Identify actual joints/gearboxes/gripper; known payload; contact geometry; support state; motion inhibition
acceptance_criterion_definition: Prespecified placement/retention criteria met; configuration remains within measured joint/load/support limits and recovery behaviour is recorded.

scope: Battery voltage/current, usable energy, rail stability, temperature, dwell/motion demand and runtime
controlled_conditions: Identify battery/regulators/protection; ambient temperature; measured duty cycle; cutoff; current/voltage calibration
acceptance_criterion_definition: Duty-cycle requirement met within identified pack/regulator limits and approved cutoff policy; no unexpected reset or measurement-reference disturbance.

scope: Stop trigger, actual detection/command delay, speed, distance, ground conditions and final actuator state
controlled_conditions: Document stop type; surface; slope; initial speed; payload; trigger timestamps; reference motion; approved limits
acceptance_criterion_definition: Measured distance/response state satisfy the declared clearance and time budget, including repeatability/uncertainty. Commanded braking and energy interruption assessed separately.

scope: Command arbitration, sequence/timestamp checks, link loss, stale commands, low-voltage indication and reset
controlled_conditions: Document authority priority; defined injected condition; firmware; expected state; restart/reset policy; timestamps
acceptance_criterion_definition: Every defined injected condition produces the specified state within its declared time budget; no unintended restart or competing authority.

scope: Gas-channel identity, heater waveform/phase, raw output, reference exposure, humidity/temperature and recovery
controlled_conditions: Verify sensor variant and analyte; define concentration unit; document reference exposure; heater phase; humidity; recovery
acceptance_criterion_definition: Channel-specific, reference-based error and response criteria met on independent exposures/days within the declared domain. No assumed chemical selectivity.

scope: Particle reference co-location, humidity, inlet conditions, time alignment and motion/dust context
controlled_conditions: Identify sensor/reference; aerosol/humidity domain; inlet; stationarity or traverse speed; synchronization
acceptance_criterion_definition: Held-out correction error, drift and validity flags meet declared criteria across documented aerosol/humidity conditions.

scope: pH buffers/temperature, conditioning transfer, electrode state, stabilization, turbidity standards, rinsing and sample identity
controlled_conditions: Identify electrode/interface and turbidity method/unit; standards; temperature; rinsing; stabilization; sample IDs
acceptance_criterion_definition: Independent check solutions/standards and repeats meet predefined error/uncertainty limits; sample handling preserves identity and contamination controls.

scope: Exact UV board, optical/reference response, pressure and temperature reference checks
controlled_conditions: Identify exact UV board; reference spectral band and angular response; pressure/temperature method; BMP180 has no RH
acceptance_criterion_definition: Conversion and reference agreement meet defined domain/error criteria. BMP180 data are not used as a relative-humidity measurement.

scope: Installed navigation sensors, synchronization, extrinsics, independent pose, obstacle clearance and degraded localization
controlled_conditions: Identify installed sensors and compute; synchronization/extrinsics; independent pose; route; obstacles; degraded-state handling
acceptance_criterion_definition: Defined route/clearance/recovery requirements met with documented takeover and failure rules. A rendered patrol scene is not a navigation test.

scope: Complete inspection, stationary sensing, staged-vessel water assessment, lightweight handling or visual-reconnaissance mission
controlled_conditions: Select one mission/configuration; define completion and abort states; sensor validity; sample/observation provenance
acceptance_criterion_definition: Mission-specific completion condition, valid observation rate, time/energy requirement and abort/recovery conditions met within the already characterized configuration.
